title: The Zany Survival of “The Physicists” Spoofs the Atomic Era and More
author: Ed Rampell
content:
Photograph by Bob Turton. Find him on Instagram @bobturtonphotography The
Actors’ Gang captures the tenor of our strange times with the troupe’s revival
of Swiss playwright Friedrich Dürrenmatt’s The Physicists, which is set in a
German sanatorium, or what’s called an “insane asylum” or “madhouse” for
poorer patients. The well-heeled inmates at Les Cerisiers appear […]
